verdict.rationale: Clerky documents an official remote MCP server at https://mcp.clerky.com/mcp, with setup instructions for Claude, ChatGPT and other assistants, scoped to the team access the user authorizes. A live probe confirms the endpoint exists and returns an OAuth-gated 401 without a token. Missing for 10: the documented tool set appears read-only and no specific tool list is evidenced, and there is no independent or community hands-on report of connecting an agent.
